subject: Agriculture
title: Herbicide-Resistant Crops
description: Learn Herbicide-Resistant Crops in one minute.

hook.text: Roundup Ready crops can survive glyphosate herbicide while weeds around them die. Monsanto built an empire on this.

buildup.text: Farmers plant Roundup Ready soybeans, spray glyphosate, and every weed dies. One chemical, total weed control.

discovery.text: By 2012, over 90% of US soybeans were Roundup Ready. Glyphosate use increased 15-fold in two decades.

twist.text: At least 50 weed species evolved glyphosate resistance. Superweeds now require multiple chemicals or hand weeding.

climax.text: The simplicity that made Roundup Ready popular also made resistance inevitable. Biology always adapts.

punchline.text: One herbicide, zero weeds—until the weeds evolved. Now: more herbicides, more problems.

quiz.question: What happened after decades of heavy glyphosate use on Roundup Ready crops?
options: At least 50 weed species evolved glyphosate resistance
